title: NFIP General Property Form and RCBAP Flood Policies (Write Your Own) — Other Flood Policy's Deductible Layer on Building Payments
content:
Other-insurance note for building payments on the NFIP General Property Form and RCBAP Flood Policies (Write Your Own) where the named insured's BizFlood Commercial Flood Policies (Surplus Lines) schedule the insured building: the deductible layer of that BizFlood policy, which this policy carries alone as primary insurer.

**Rule.** The other flood policy's deductible layer a building payment uses is settled as follows: when that BizFlood policy schedules the address with a building value and the building is in flood zone V or VE, it is the BizFlood tier's V-zone deductible percentage of the location's value at the time of loss, never less than the BizFlood tier's V-zone minimum deductible, that value being the one on that policy's adjuster's latest report for the location and the date of loss and, when its adjuster has filed no report for them, the building and contents values its statement of values schedules for the location added together; when that BizFlood policy schedules the address with a building value and the building is outside flood zones V and VE, it is that BizFlood policy's flat deductible per location; otherwise no other flood policy's deductible applies and the layer is the sum of the building limit and the contents limit, so the whole sworn building amount is carried alone.

**Which BizFlood policy and location.** The BizFlood policy is the named insured's BizFlood policy that schedules the building's address, in force on the date of loss and not written excess of the National Flood Insurance Program. The building's location on that BizFlood policy is the location number its statement of values gives the building's address.

## Records read

The BizFlood statement of values entry for the building's address (location number, building value, contents value), the BizFlood tier's V-zone deductible percentage and V-zone minimum deductible, that policy's flat deductible per location, and the BizFlood adjuster's latest report for the location and the date of loss; from this policy, the flood zone of the building and its building and contents limits.

## Ladder

| BizFlood policy (in force, not excess) schedules the address with a building value | Flood zone of the building | Layer |
|---|---|---|
| yes | V or VE | the V-zone deductible percentage of the location's value at the time of loss, never less than the V-zone minimum deductible |
| yes | any other zone | the BizFlood policy's flat deductible per location |
| no | any | the building limit plus the contents limit of this policy |

## Location value cases (hypothetical; building in zone VE)

- The BizFlood adjuster's latest report for the location and the date of loss gives a location value of 800,000: the layer is the BizFlood tier's V-zone deductible percentage of 800,000, or the BizFlood tier's V-zone minimum deductible when that minimum is higher.
- The BizFlood adjuster has filed no report for the location and the date of loss; the statement of values schedules a building value of 300,000 and a contents value of 100,000: the location value is 400,000, and the layer is the V-zone deductible percentage of 400,000, never less than the V-zone minimum deductible.
- The same building in zone AE: the layer is that BizFlood policy's flat deductible per location, whatever the location value.
